column1: # Real SkyBlock item names, for SkyBlockNameSnapshotTest.
# NotEnoughUpdates item repository -- the community's canonical SkyBlock
# on 2026-08-31, from 8726 distinct names across its items/ directory.
# Only the names the mod actually uses are kept. Regenerate after adding
# one; a name this file does not carry fails the build unless it is on
# the test's allowlist with a reason.
# PET      NEU stores it as "[Lvl {LVL}] X"; the drop is X
# ENCHANT  an enchanted book; the name is in its lore, not its title
# TROPHY   a trophy fish species, which ships as four tiered items
